context:
Goal: drain the open-PR pile without losing work.
Problem (cannot undo): closing a PR is a visible act on GitHub, and you asked to approve one close list.
Based on (measured): the three-pass sort checked 716 open PRs; 18 PRs either have every change already on main (4) or are wholly contained in an open replacement PR based on main with no PR stacked on them (14).
Based on (measured): a second check found 32 more PRs that looked closable were not safe to close (22 judged only by a script, 10 with other PRs built on top), so those stay open.
Based on (ruling): close-replaced-at-open (owner, 2026-11-09 21:27 CST) closes a PR as replaced when its replacement opens; these 14 were opened before that rule ran on them, and you asked at 12:44 CST Nov 10 to approve the one close list from the sort, so the list waits for your word.
Departs from: main — closes 18 open PRs. The list: #1042→#1971 #1850→#1971 #1418 #1422 #1431 #1446→#1766 #1609→#1810 #1785→#2293 #1842 #2235→#2265 #1846 #1851→#1861 #1909→#2050 #2091→#2015 #1581 #1635 #1709 #2140→main.
Meanwhile: the coordinator closes nothing until you answer.

options.gain: 18 fewer open PRs, and nothing is lost: each head is pushed to archive/<branch> first, and each close comment names its replacement.
options.how: The coordinator pushes each head to archive/<branch>, then closes the 18 with a comment naming each replacement.
options.label: Close all 18 (Recommended)
options.lose: If a replacement PR is later dropped, its closed PR must be reopened by hand.

options.gain: No PR depends on an open replacement.
options.how: The coordinator archives and closes only the 4 whose changes are all on main.
options.label: Close only the 4 already on main

reply: You answered in chat at 14:56 CST: "close all 18" (option a). The coordinator pushed all 18 heads to archive/<branch> and closed each PR with a comment naming its replacement or main (14:58 CST).
title: Close the 18 open PRs that main or an open replacement already holds?
why: It closes only PRs whose every change is on main or in an open replacement, and it archives each head first.
